summary: Comprehensive testing of Heroic HIFI Foundation website with OTP verification, expanded registration, PAN mandatory donations, 80G certificate generation, and admin dashboard with Users tab. Fixed critical OTP verification bug and missing users state variable.

critical_bugs.issue: FIXED - TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes
critical_bugs.impact: Was blocking entire OTP verification flow for registration and donations

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED - Missing users state variable causing 'users is not defined' error

passed_tests: OTP sending for registration and donation purposes
OTP verification with debug OTP display
Registration with expanded fields (name, email, password, phone, age, DOB, address, PAN, Aadhaar)
Registration requires OTP verification (rejects without valid otp_token)
Admin login with new fields in response (phone, pan_number, aadhaar_number, address, age, dob)
Donation creation requires PAN number (mandatory field)
Donation order creation with OTP verification for non-logged users
Donation order creation rejects without auth or OTP
80G certificate PDF generation for donations with PAN
80G certificate returns 400 error for donations without PAN
Admin dashboard loads with all 5 tabs (Overview, Donations, Volunteers, Queries, Users)
Admin Users tab shows all users with delete buttons (except admin)
Admin cannot delete own account
Admin can delete other users
Donations tab shows certificate download links for donations with PAN
Registration page multi-step form (details -> OTP verification)
Donate page pre-fills data for logged-in users
Donate page shows OTP verification for non-logged users
All admin endpoints require proper authentication
Non-admin users get 403 on admin endpoints
Razorpay integration returns null order_id when keys not configured
Activity logging working in background
All CRUD operations for donations, volunteers, queries
Status updates for all entities work correctly
